newsitem.title: USA: MK Rail says to sell unit to Ri-Del.
newsitem.headline: MK Rail says to sell unit to Ri-Del.

text.p: MK Rail Corp said Tuesday it has signed a letter of intent to sell a product line of signs it manufactures for the railroad industry to Ri-Del Manufacturing Inc for about $1.3 million in cash.
The transaction is expected to close during the fourth quarter. MK Rail said the unit to be sold is a non-core product line with annual sales of about $2 million.
Power Parts Co, a subsidiary of MK Rail, will retain distribution rights for the signs, but will no longer manufacture them.
The company said the sale is part of its strategy for Power Parts to remain a distributor of the products while reducing overhead costs.
Ri-Del, a private company based in Chicago, is a fabricator and stamper with welding, machining and printing capabilities.
MK Rail manufactures and distributes engineered locomotive components, provides maintainance for locomotives and manufactures switcher locomotives.
